title: Interactive Tracking: A Human-in-the-Loop Paradigm with Memory-Augmented Adaptation

layout.note: Three full-width bands stacked top to bottom (video frames with boxes, user prompts on a timeline, crop strips of the tracker's target), all cut into four time-aligned columns; coloured arcs run over the top band and grey rules separate the four crop segments.

lesson: Show an interaction over time as aligned bands: video frames with coloured target boxes, the user's prompts dropped as coloured dots on a timeline, and the resulting target crops. Keep one colour per interaction type through all three bands so the reader sees which prompt caused which change.
